## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the chosen solution.

## Validation

- [ ] `go test ./...`
- [ ] `go vet ./...`
- [ ] Formatting and lint checks pass
- [ ] Database-specific behavior has focused tests
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior changed
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, private SQL or sensitive result data

## Evidence

Include terminal screenshots for visible TUI changes and sanitized reproduction SQL for editor or driver changes.

## Review notes

Call out tradeoffs, compatibility considerations and follow-up work. The submitter is responsible for understanding and validating all contributed code, including tool-assisted drafts.
